paper.title: MS-Temba: Multi-Scale Temporal Mamba for Understanding Long Untrimmed Videos

repository.official_link_evidence: CVF PDF project https://mstemba.github.io and author-owned official repo title/README; actual pinned model code read

license.attribution_risk: Retain upstream Mamba/Vim/timm notices; root license is not a claim every vendored subtree has identical provenance.

core_sources.role: MSTemba, VisionMamba, branch slicing/reinterleave, fuser, C-state alignment
bidirectional selective SSM exposes C states
source selective_scan_ref algebra; input-dependent real B/C, softplus dt and Euler input term

adaptation.objective: MSE(mean over actual learned XYZ whole-window average velocity), no auxiliary losses
adaptation.diagnostic_small_configuration: Only explicitly selected server scientific tests may use reduced widths/depths. Such tests do not admit the full profile or silently replace it.

outputs.semantic: real learned XYZ window-average velocity in m/s
outputs.xy_metric: slice the same XYZ prediction; no separate XY model or zero Z

adaptation.permissions: Existing six-axis IMU and train average-velocity labels only. Reference orientation is the admitted task-view rotation, not a separate model input. No runtime calibration/scaling statistics, pose, image, text, initial velocity, extra sensor or test-driven choice.
adaptation.loss_identity_policy: set_loss rejects all non-MSE losses and nonempty kwargs; adding source auxiliary or SSL terms requires a separately named pre-registered identity and budget.
retained: three SEQUENTIAL scales Linear/LayerNorm/GELU with widths256/384/576, dilations1/2/3 and separate phase weights
zero padding to dilation multiple, exact phase interleave and removal before pooling; T200 third scale pads one token
independent forward/backward causal depthwise-conv and selective dt/A/B/C/D cores; shared x/z input projection, reverse entire x/z, reverse output and average before shared output projection
project all scale outputs to576, share a single LayerNorm across scales, SUM then a depth1 bidirectional SSM interaction fuser
source final outer initializer: all Linear weights truncated normal std0.02, every Linear bias ZERO (including dt_proj), LayerNorm weight1/bias0
true time-mean pooling and a learned Linear576->XYZ
omitted: dense multilabel classification and unused image/block heads
C-state cosine alignment objective; its source function 'diversity' means1-cosine ALIGNMENT, not repulsion
auxiliary scale heads/BCE/action labels and all loss coefficients
fused CUDA selective scan, causal-conv1d extension, Triton fused RMSNorm/addnorm and timm dependency

scan_reference.A: negative exp(A_log); A_log initialized log(1..N), independent forward/backward parameters
scan_reference.B_C: input-dependent projections (B,N,T), not fixed S4D matrices; shared over inner channels exactly as the source branch
scan_reference.initialization: zero state every invocation; source outer final Linear initializer supersedes generic Mamba log-uniform dt_proj initialization
scan_reference.numeric_scope: FP32 accumulator for fp16/bf16/fp32, FP64 when explicitly given double tensors; source ref casts to FP32. Real A/B/C subset used by pinned BiMamba-v2 only.
scan_reference.low_precision_parity: NOT verified. Default scientific/native validation requires AMP=false/FP32. Eager TembaSSMBlock uses native addition with no explicit FP32 residual cast: FP32 selective-scan accumulation is NOT source residual_in_fp32 or fused addnorm parity. Changing this later requires separately specified arithmetic and scientific tests.
unsupported: complex/grouped scan variants not used by this pinned model
fused-kernel numerical identity or speed claim
scan_reference.asymptotic_risk: Python recurrence creates an autograd chain per phase/sample. Default B128/T200/full widths unmeasured; an eager reference may be too slow for budget and is not capacity GO.

paper_code_differences: MSE-only architecture identity deliberately omits source C alignment/scale BCE/classification.
Fused add+RMSNorm is expressed by eager algebra; no bitwise equivalence or extension performance claim.
Final outer initializer is followed, rather than the intermediate generic Mamba dt initialization.
Explicit float64 diagnostic support extends the FP32-only source reference, without changing advertised fp32 training.

Upstream residual_in_fp32 low-precision/fused behavior is not implemented as an explicit residual cast; no AMP or low-precision source parity is claimed. Default future scientific/native validation is FP32/AMP=false.

static_inspection.execution: NOT performed; no framework imports, pytest collection, model execution, CPU/GPU or training
